metadata.description: AgentAvow — is this tool safe for your agent to connect? Safe to connect, Review, or Do not connect, with a signed trust score you can verify offline.

plugins.name: agentavow-trust
plugins.description: At your next session, Claude tells you which of your MCP servers and direct dependencies are safe. Anything you add with `claude mcp add` is checked before it is added. Each result leads with Safe to connect, Review before you connect, or Do not connect, over a signed 0-100 trust score you can verify offline, plus the AgentAvow connector, a /scan command, and a per-call gate for Do not connect or changed tools.
